_comment: guard_flavor_text_lumora.json - what the Oasis Wardens inside Lumora say (Scripts/guard_npc.gd flavor_text_path, set on Lumora's guards; the Outskirts guards keep guard_flavor_text.json). hail: when you hail them; banter: to each other; engage: when they fight. {word} = a clickable keyword (guard_topics.json). DRAFT lines, 2026-09-26: edit freely.
hail: Welcome to Lumora, traveller. Keep the peace inside the walls and you'll have no trouble from us.
Rooms at the Sunlit Rest, healing at the Temple of the Dawn. Fines at the courthouse, if it comes to that.
The oasis is free to all. Drink, rest, and move along.
Looking for your guild? The Hall of Arms, the Lycaeum, the Temple... and Old Town, for the other sort.
Strike a citizen in these streets and you'll answer to the Wardens. We don't forget faces.
The Commander's at the Citadel, if you've business with the Wardens.
Mind your purse in the bazaar. The Sandveil smile with all their teeth.
Quiet day. The crier's the loudest thing in the city, and I'd like it to stay that way.
New to the city? The notice board in Citadel Plaza has what you need to know.
Stay out of the Cisterns unless you know someone down there. And if you do, I don't want to know.
banter: Another fine is paid, another fool learns. The Magistrate's ledger never ends.
Crier's been shouting about Kordova caravans since dawn. My ears are ringing.
Old Town's quiet tonight. That's never a good sign.
The Sunlit Rest's stew is better than the barracks'. Don't tell the cook.
Saw a Sandveil broker counting coins in the shade again. Always counting.
The oasis looks like glass at dusk. Worth the watch, some nights.
If the dark moon comes and the vault's still lit, I'll call it a good year.
Heard the temple healed a whole caravan's worth of snakebite yesterday.
engage: By the Sacred Flame, stand down!
You picked the wrong city to start trouble in.
Lumora is under the Wardens' protection!
